svg.text: N auto = 5 from the bin-name array
The bracketed squares on the far left are the four auto-indexing tunnels and the error
shift register from the s7-batch For Loop - this is the same block diagram, continued.
FPY divides passed by (units tested - tester errors), so a tester fault removes the unit from
the yield calculation instead of counting it as a DUT failure. Coerce to DBL BEFORE dividing
or integer division silently truncates 24/30 to 0.
The Pareto loop tunnel carrying A2 is NOT indexed: every iteration must see the whole
30-element array to count one bin. Indexing it would hand each iteration a single string.
